description:
The Cumberland Cottage is a stunning 1930s restoration, eclectically furnished and bursting with high-end details like a chef's kitchen, king master suite, well appointed bedrooms, and dedicated parking. There's also an incredible outdoor oasis, with total privacy for your hot tub enjoyment, a gas fire pit, and sparkling lights overhead.

The Cottage is close to all the action of Nashville, but tucked away on a quiet residential street. It's the perfect base for your adventure!

Other things to note
Enjoy our lightning fast high speed internet service, perfect for streaming the free YouTube TV with DVR, your own Netflix/Amazon/Disney+ account, or using Zoom for work.
